acceptance: A scheduled workflow runs both families at SF=1 and reports per-query agreement with the answer sets
The lane is non-blocking and its runtime and memory are recorded
Disagreements are reported with the classifier output (dfparity-t14) where available
context: Source: DataFrame query parity proposal v3 (item T18). Project owner does NOT accept earlier reviewers' TPC-H claims.
description: Run both DataFrame families and the SQL surface at SF=1 under the qualification binding and compare their results value by value to the official answer sets, an oracle independent of DuckDB. Scheduled lane only, never blocking. SF=1 is heavy (a full probe took about 450 s and 3.5 GB peak RSS on the author's Mac, with pandas Q78 timing out at 180 s), so it needs the Q78 fix and explicit approval for the resource use.
